Package org.example.magazynieruz.controller

Class AdminController

java.lang.Object
org.example.magazynieruz.controller.AdminController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/admin") public class AdminController extends Object
REST controller for administrative operations. Provides comprehensive management endpoints for organisations, users, warehouses, locations, and products. All endpoints require ADMIN role.
